# Study tools, Send to and Anki

## Architecture invariants

- Study tools (owner request 2026-10-20, [spec](docs/specs/2026-10-20-study-tools-from-migaku-and-jidoujisho.md)), ideas from Migaku and jidoujisho with no code, assets, data, keys or endpoints of theirs: play modes (pause after each line, read first, listen first, dictation, repeat each line, pause on lines with one new word) and skip silence only send pause, seek and speed scripts to the one page video and need the full transcript; Dictation (owner pick 2026-11-09, [spec](docs/specs/2026-11-09-dictation-play-mode.md)) pauses like Pause after each line, hides each transcript row until Check or Show reveals it, and types answers in a box under the transcript (`ui/Dictation.kt`, checked by `data/DictationCheck.kt`); answers and reveals live only in memory, and outside the panel (full screen, overlay, TV, live subtitles) it acts like Listen first; known words live in `files/known-words/` (not preferences, so Reset all settings keeps them) and give the subtitle panel's "Known %" score; Known words is off by default (owner decision 2026-10-20) and the word card's first "I know this word" offers once to turn it on as Automatic (Manual too): with Automatic a word becomes known after it played in 10 lines (5/10/20), each line counted once per video, saved words never, with counts in `files/known-words/<language>.seen` written at most every 30 s and on pause, and "I know this word" marks at once and restarts a count; one split Send to button (owner design 2026-10-23, [spec](docs/specs/2026-10-23-send-to-button-and-ankiconnect.md)) on the word card and in Practice → Export sends to the app last picked on its ▾ list or in Settings (`send_to_app`): AnkiDroid by default, through its public content provider and runtime permission, never its library (on many phones AnkiDroid answers only while it runs in the background, so a refused card offers Open AnkiDroid), or AnkiConnect at `http://127.0.0.1:8765` only (AnkiConnect Android, Yomitan, asbplayer; `network_security_config.xml` allows cleartext to that address and nothing else; AnkiConnect Android cannot make decks or note types, so cards fall back to Default and Basic there); cards carry sound (owner pick 2026-11-09, [spec](docs/specs/2026-11-09-anki-word-and-sentence-audio.md)): Flashcards & Anki has a Front / Back / Off pick each for Word sound, Sentence sound and Picture (owner pick 2026-11-12, [spec](docs/specs/2026-11-13-card-sound-places-and-background-loop.md); defaults: word sound where Card front puts it, sentence sound on the back, picture off; the back template starts with `{{FrontSide}}`, so never offer "front and back"): the word in the word card's voice and the line's real sound, which a page script (`ui/LineAudioScripts.kt`) records from the page video's `captureStream()` while it plays (the last 90 s, in memory; it only listens, never downloads, and asks for no permission) and only while Send to can be used; clips are `.m4a` in `files/line-audio/` (left out of cloud backups), new cards use the "TripleSub Replay v5" note type here (the fork's v4 plus the two sound fields; upstream's "DualSub Replay audio" type is only an AnkiConnect fallback; AnkiDroid can't add fields to an old type, owner pick 2026-11-12, [spec](docs/specs/2026-11-12-triplesub-anki-v5-card-media.md)), media reach AnkiDroid through the `${applicationId}.cardaudio` provider (`data/CardMediaProvider.kt`, which reports `.m4a` as `audio/mp4` because AnkiDroid names its copy after the reported type and Android's table says `audio/mpeg`, which made `.mp3`) with a one-copy read grant, a silent clip never goes on a card, and a card sent before its line ended gets its clip once the line has played (`anki_audio_pending`, `ui/LineAudioCapture.kt`); cards also carry a picture and a chosen front (owner pick 2026-11-10, [spec](docs/specs/2026-11-10-anki-card-picture-and-front.md)): with Picture on Front or Back a still the page draws from its own video into a canvas while the word's line shows (`webLinePictureScript`, `files/line-pictures/`, left out of cloud backups), else the video's thumbnail from `i.ytimg.com`, in the Source field above the link (no new note type); Card front (Word and sentence by default, Word, Sentence, Listening) is the note type's card template, set again only when the pick changes (`ankidroid_card_front` / `ankiconnect_card_front`), and on AnkiConnect Android's Basic cards it picks the Front and Back fields; never add a separate button per app; the blur box is a page element over the player. Every tool has its own switch: play modes, skip silence and the blur box under Settings → Study tools, Known words and Character details under Word learning, Send to and card audio and pictures under Flashcards & Anki; the assistant can change them (`page_token_captions` waits for a tap).
